findings.claim: 前十大客戶合計僅約占 FY2025 總淨銷售 6%，公司稱無重大客戶集中度
findings.excerpt: We have no meaningful customer concentration as our top ten customers accounted for approximately 6% of total net sales for our 2025 fiscal year.

findings.claim: 應收帳款無單一重大客戶餘額；公司持續做客戶信用評估，通常不要求擔保品，部分客戶有個人保證
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 財報附註
findings.excerpt: The Company generally does not require collateral. However, the Company, in certain instances, has obtained personal guarantees from certain customers. There is no significant balance with any individual customer.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋未見 2026 年信評機構降評或下修財測；僅見 7/29 8-K 初始 FY2026 財測（淨銷售 $4.5B–$4.6B），未見下修。
